"""Camera-guided controller for the single live episode. No reset or privileged state."""
import json, sys, pathlib

obs=None
count=0
cmd=None

def save(o):
 global obs,count,cmd
 obs=o
 d=f'/app/runs/{count:03d}'
 o.save(d)
 p=dict(zip(o.meta['proprio']['layout'],o.meta['proprio']['now']))
 pathlib.Path('/app/output/latest.json').write_text(json.dumps(o.meta,indent=2))
 ims=[]
 for c,im in o.last.items():
  pic=Image.fromarray(im).resize((640,480))
  ImageDraw.Draw(pic).text((8,8),c,fill='red')
  ims.append(pic)
 montage=Image.new('RGB',(640*3,500*((len(ims)+2)//3)))
 for i,im in enumerate(ims):montage.paste(im,(640*(i%3),500*(i//3)))
 montage.save('/app/output/views.jpg')
 print(json.dumps({'saved':d,'proprio':p,'time_left':o.meta.get('time_left_s')}),flush=True)
 count+=1

def run(q):
 global cmd
 op=q.get('op','obs')
 if op=='obs':save(r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none',seconds=q.get('seconds',0)))
 elif op=='move':
  if cmd is None:
   p=dict(zip(obs.meta['proprio']['layout'],obs.meta['proprio']['now']))
   cmd=np.array([p[k] for k in spec['action_types']['ee_pose']['layout']],float)
  target=cmd.copy()
  for k,v in q.get('set',{}).items():target[int(k)]=v
  if 'right' in q:target[:len(q['right'])]=q['right']
  if 'left' in q:target[6:6+len(q['left'])]=q['left']
  if 'rh' in q:target[12:18]=q['rh']
  if 'lh' in q:target[18:24]=q['lh']
  n=q.get('steps',60)
  a=np.linspace(cmd,target,n)
  if q.get('hold',0):a=np.vstack([a,np.tile(target,(q['hold'],1))])
  save(r.submit('ee_pose',a,include_depth=True,video='none',note=q.get('note','')))
  cmd=target
  np.save('/app/output/last_cmd.npy',cmd)
 elif op=='init':cmd=np.array(q['cmd'],float)
 else:raise ValueError(op)

save(r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none'))
print('READY',flush=True)
for line in sys.stdin:
 try:run(json.loads(line))
 except Exception as e:print(type(e).__name__+': '+str(e),flush=True)
